FAQ.title: Got Questions? We Have Answers
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about learning, schedules, and curriculum at Webind Edu.
FAQ.a1: Webind Edu is designed for elementary students (grades 4–6), junior and senior high school students, as well as university beginners wanting to master computers, coding, and AI through 1-on-1 private sessions. Our tracks progress systematically: Digital Starter & Coding Starter for beginners, through to Web Developer, AI Starter, or AI Developer.
FAQ.q2: Do I need prior programming experience?
FAQ.a2: Not at all. Absolute beginners can start from Digital Starter (computer fundamentals and safety) or Coding Starter (computational thinking and coding logic). For Web Developer, basic coding logic is recommended, and for AI Developer basic Python knowledge is helpful. You can also start with our free trial session.
FAQ.a3: Sessions are 1-on-1 private, 90 minutes each (60 minutes for elementary), primarily in-person at the student's home (home tutoring) or online via Google Meet if physically occupied. Schedules are tailored with parents, and duo sessions (2 students) are available with a 25% discount per student.
FAQ.q4: What will I achieve after completing a program?
FAQ.a4: Every program concludes with a real project: complete document packages in Digital Starter, interactive games/calculators in Coding Starter, live online websites in Web Developer, AI ethics handbooks in AI Starter, or trained machine learning models in AI Developer, along with an Official Certificate of Completion.
FAQ.q5: Can parents monitor their child's progress?
FAQ.a5: Yes. Parents receive concise reports after every session via WhatsApp and our Webind Edu platform dashboard, covering covered topics, mastered skills, and tutor notes. At completion, a comprehensive evaluation report is provided.
FAQ.q6: Is the curriculum aligned with school subjects?
FAQ.a6: Our curriculum aligns directly with official textbooks and the 8 Elements of Informatics Learning Outcomes (CP) under the Kurikulum Merdeka Kemendikdasmen (BK, TIK, SK, JKI, AD, AP, DSI, PLB), enriched with hands-on practice and personalized pacing.
FAQ.q7: Does the student need their own laptop?
FAQ.a7: Yes, students are encouraged to use their own laptop or computer at home to practice and save projects independently. Standard laptops (Windows, macOS, or Chrome OS) with at least 4 GB RAM are fully adequate.
FAQ.q8: How much does it cost, and what about transport fees?
FAQ.a8: All home tutoring rates are All-In (Zero Transport Fees / Rp0) with no hidden fuel or distance charges. We offer Full Program Tracks, Monthly 4-Session packages, Single Sessions, and a 25% discount for duo learning.
FAQ.q9: What if the chosen program is not suitable?
FAQ.a9: Students can transition programs anytime. On monthly plans, transitions occur at the next billing cycle, while on program tracks, lesson adjustments are tailored with the tutor. We recommend the free trial session beforehand.
FAQ.q10: Is there a trial session available?
FAQ.a10: Yes. We offer a free 30–45 minute consultation and placement session that parents can attend to sample introductory materials and evaluate student starting level.
FAQ.q11: What are the scheduling and cancellation rules?
FAQ.a11: Schedules are flexible. Rescheduling can be requested up to 24 hours prior to the session. Payments are completed upfront via bank transfer or QRIS.
FAQ.q12: Must parents be present during the session?
FAQ.a12: For home tutoring sessions, we ask that a parent or adult family member remains at home throughout the session for mutual comfort and safety. Parents are welcome to observe at any time.
FAQ.q13: How does Webind Edu teach AI to students?
FAQ.a13: We teach AI as a learning accelerator, not as a shortcut to bypass critical thinking. Students learn to verify AI accuracy, protect personal data privacy, avoid plagiarism, and respect academic integrity rules.
